newsitem.title: UK: Firstbus says Q1 trade ahead of last yr.
newsitem.headline: Firstbus says Q1 trade ahead of last yr.

text.p: British transport group Firstbus Plc said on Thursday its trading in the first three months of its current financial year has been ahead of the same period last year.

The company's chairman, Trevor Smallwood, told the annual meeting of shareholders its two recent acquisitions, Great Eastern Railway and CentreWest, were both trading ahead of its initial expectations.

The company separately announced its offer for Southampton Citybus was unconditional in all respects after it had received acceptances from holders of 1.2 million shares, representing 99.25 percent of Citybus' ordinary share capital.
The offer valued Citybus at 11.1 million stg.
